extracted.intended_audience: general readers and historians interested in 19th-century British popular entertainment, fairs, and theatre history
extracted.subtask_description: A narrative, biographical chapter recounting performers, showmen, and popular entertainments (Bartholomew Fair, travelling theatres, menageries) in early 19th-century Britain, including anecdotes about Edmund Kean and other notable figures. The text is descriptive and historical rather than prescriptive.
